notes.subject: אפס כי
notes.rationale: 'except/only that' (KJV, Geneva) vs 'surely/because' (ASV, JPS read אֶפֶס כִּי as emphatic 'howbeit, because' rather than exceptive).

notes.subject: ברך יברכך
notes.rationale: Infinitive absolute + verb doubling — 'blessing he will bless you' — rendered as single phrase 'blesim yu tru'; intensification lost in Tok Pisin as in English.

notes.subject: man i no gat samting
notes.rationale: אביון is 'destitute/needy one'; Tok Pisin phrase keeps the destitution picture rather than a generic 'poor'.

notes.subject: ⟨yu⟩
notes.rationale: Object pronoun of the doubled verb supplied once, since Tok Pisin cannot keep the infinitive-absolute doubling.

translation: Nogat tasol — i no bai i gat man i no gat samting long yu; bilong wanem Yahwe i blesim ⟨yu⟩ tru long graun we Yahwe Elohim bilong yu i givim long yu olsem hap graun bilong lukautim ⟨en⟩.
